name: N2N
recent: N2N Connect 宣布每股 1 仙的第一次中期股息，除权日为 2026 年 12 月 4 日，派发日为 12 月 28 日。公司也更改了财政年度结束日，并发布了季度业绩。一名大股东在 9 月至 11 月间多次申报股权变动。
notable: 宣布每股 1 仙的第一次中期股息，除权日为 2026 年 12 月 4 日。

risks: 一名大股东在 9 月至 11 月间多次申报股权变动。
董事 Chua Hock Seng 于 2026 年 11 月 25 日通过配偶增持 10,000 股。
earnings: 最近一季（2026-06-30）营收为 21,719,000 令吉，净利为 850,000 令吉，净利率 3.9%。营收环比增长 5.1%，但净利环比下降 70.2%；营收同比下降 16.3%，净利同比下降 81.7%。

recent_en: N2N Connect declared a first interim dividend of 1 sen per share, with ex-date on 4 Dec 2026 and payment on 28 Dec 2026. The company also changed its financial year end and released quarterly results. A substantial shareholder filed multiple changes in interest between September and November.
notable_en: Declared a first interim dividend of 1 sen per share, with ex-date on 4 Dec 2026.
Released quarterly results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026.
risks_en: A substantial shareholder filed multiple changes in interest between September and November.
Director Chua Hock Seng acquired 10,000 shares via his spouse on 25 Nov 2026.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter (2026-06-30), revenue was MYR 21,719,000 and net income was MYR 850,000, with a net margin of 3.9%. Revenue rose 5.1% QoQ but net income fell 70.2% QoQ; revenue declined 16.3% YoY and net income declined 81.7% YoY.
